title: Doctoral Studies in Asset Pricing
college: ANU College of Business and Economics
summary: This course develops modern asset pricing theory and provides students with an in-depth knowledge of asset pricing models.
requisiteText: To be eligible to enroll in the course, students must be enrolled in an RSFAS or RSE PhD program and have successfully completed undergraduate studies in Investments or its equivalent at a recognized academic institution. Masters students in Finance with a GPA of 6.5 who have completed FINM7008, FINM7007 and FINM7041 may also apply to enroll in the course. This course will be a departmental consent enrollment course.

title: Finance Masters Thesis
college: ANU College of Business and Economics
summary: This course requires students to complete a 12 to 24-unit masters thesis in the field of Finance.
requisiteText:
Students entering this course must have a GPA of at least 6.5 at time of application and have arranged a supervisor for their thesis.
Students who wish to undertake a Masters thesis should contact the course convenor once the above has been arranged to confirm their eligibility.
Important note for students: When 48 units remain in your program, you must register your intent to enrol in FINM8500 by contacting the Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Statistics to ensure the correct enrolment in the semester prior to undertaking FINM8500.
